roles.title: ML & training engineer
roles.headline: Build models that train reliably.
roles.description: Turn a model idea into a tested training system, from the first update to recovery after an interruption.
responsibilities: Design data pipelines and resumable training
Debug losses, state, and model quality
roles.portfolio: A seeded training system with held-out evaluation, complete checkpoint recovery, and a performance report.
roles.readiness: Demonstrate that your model trains, evaluates, resumes correctly, and produces reproducible results.

roles.title: Research engineer
roles.headline: Turn mathematical ideas into experiments.
roles.description: Implement a method, inspect its gradients, and test whether the evidence supports the idea.
responsibilities: Run controlled experiments and numerical checks
roles.portfolio: A small research implementation with checked gradients or posterior diagnostics, baselines, and reproducible results.
roles.readiness: Explain the assumptions of your method and support a conclusion with correctness checks and an appropriate baseline.

roles.title: Scientific ML engineer
roles.headline: Simulate systems. Learn their hidden parameters.
roles.description: Use differentiable computing to connect physical models, observations, and learned components.
roles.portfolio: A differentiable inverse problem that recovers a physical parameter and predicts held-out trajectories.
roles.readiness: Verify parameter recovery, gradient accuracy, and simulation stability on a stated test problem.

roles.title: RL engineer
roles.headline: Build agents that learn by interacting.
roles.description: Connect functional environments, batched experience, and policy updates into a repeatable learning experiment.
roles.portfolio: A trained policy compared with a simple baseline across multiple seeds, with reproducible learning curves.
roles.readiness: Show that the evaluation measures policy improvement rather than a lucky seed or a changed environment.

roles.title: Accelerator & performance engineer
roles.headline: Find bottlenecks. Scale the right computation.
roles.description: Explain where time and memory go, then improve a workload with evidence rather than guesses.
responsibilities: Diagnose compute, input, and communication bottlenecks
roles.portfolio: A sharded workload or custom kernel with trace-backed analysis, correctness checks, and a measured speed comparison.
roles.readiness: Preserve correctness, separate compile time from execution, and justify the improvement using workload measurements.

roles.title: Inference & deployment engineer
roles.headline: Make a trained model usable.
roles.description: Bridge experiments and deployed workloads, with tested predictions and a capacity plan grounded in measurements.
responsibilities: Plan batching, capacity, and rollout behavior
roles.portfolio: A verified inference artifact with a workload definition, latency/throughput measurements, and a batching plan.
roles.readiness: Reproduce exported predictions and defend the serving plan under a clearly stated workload.

roles.title: JAX / accelerator operations engineer
roles.headline: Keep real workloads observable and recoverable.
roles.description: Make accelerator jobs reproducible, diagnose failures, and plan resources for dependable operation.
responsibilities: Manage accelerator jobs and runtime lifecycle
Monitor throughput, stalls, and checkpoint health
Test failure recovery and plan capacity
roles.portfolio: A restartable accelerator workload with logs, a tested recovery runbook, and a measured resource plan.
roles.readiness: Detect and diagnose a controlled failure, restore full workload state, and explain operational tradeoffs.
